subject.title: [Refactor] Abstract OAuth flow parameters out of LLM transport core

question: Should the unidentified OAuth values remain provider-owned through existing hooks, or is there a specific shared host-policy value that warrants a new `AiTransportHost` API?
rationale: The proposed contract crosses a published library boundary and may duplicate existing plugin hooks, so the permanent owner cannot be selected safely without the concrete value and consumer.

options.title: Require a concrete gap
options.body: Ask for the exact hardcoded value, caller, and blocked provider, then use an existing provider hook unless that evidence proves it cannot fit.

options.title: Sponsor a host port
options.body: Add a narrow `AiTransportHost` port only for shared application policy that every library host must inject.

recommendation.title: Require a concrete gap
recommendation.body: Ask for the exact hardcoded value, caller, and blocked provider, then use an existing provider hook unless that evidence proves it cannot fit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent transport-policy centralization makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for deciding the provider-versus-host boundary.
